Choose the preferred flight and compare the baggage/benefits included in the available ValueJet fare products.
Enter the passenger and contact information and complete payment through ValueJet's official booking flow.
Save the confirmation and booking details for online check-in, Manage My Booking and customer support.
notes: ValueJet currently publishes ValueLite, ValuePlus, ValuePremium and ValueBusiness fare products with different baggage and priority benefits.
The airline's website supports domestic and West African routes and can display route-specific availability.
Use the fare details shown at booking time because included extras can differ by product.

title: How to check in online with ValueJet
summary: ValueJet's website check-in route for an existing reservation, allowing eligible passengers to complete check-in before reaching the airport through the airline's Online Check-In service.
feeNote: ValueJet does not state a separate fee for using the Online Check-In service on its public website.
timeline: ValueJet's public homepage exposes Online Check-In but does not publish one durable opening/closing window on the surfaced page; confirm the live check-in window shown for the booking.
requirements: An existing ValueJet reservation eligible for online check-in
The booking/passenger information requested by ValueJet's Online Check-In form
Valid photo identification and any travel documents required for the route
Enough time to complete any airport baggage drop and boarding requirements after online check-in
steps: Open ValueJet's official website and select Online Check-In.
Enter the reservation and passenger information requested by the airline's check-in form.
Complete the seat/check-in prompts shown for the eligible booking.
Save the boarding or check-in confirmation generated for the passenger.
Arrive at the airport within the airline's live reporting/baggage-drop instructions and present the required travel identification.
notes: ValueJet's public site currently exposes Online Check-In but does not show a stable universal cutoff on the surfaced page.
Passengers with checked baggage must still complete the required airport baggage handover.
Use the current reservation/check-in screen for any booking-specific restrictions.

title: How ValueJet baggage allowance works by fare
summary: ValueJet's current fare-based baggage guide covering the published 7kg cabin allowance and checked-baggage inclusions for ValueLite, ValuePlus, ValuePremium and ValueBusiness.
feeLabel: Included baggage depends on the fare product
feeNote: ValueJet's website shows the baggage included with each fare product. Extra baggage pricing is dynamic and should be checked in the live booking or Manage My Booking flow before purchase.
timeline: Baggage allowance applies to the booked fare. Any additional baggage should be purchased or confirmed before airport processing where the booking offers that option.
requirements: A confirmed ValueJet fare product so the passenger can identify the baggage included with the ticket
Cabin baggage that remains within the published 7kg allowance and size rules shown by ValueJet
Checked baggage within the number/weight allowance included in the selected fare, or a paid extra-baggage option when offered
steps: Open the ValueJet booking or reservation and confirm whether the ticket is ValueLite, ValuePlus, ValuePremium or ValueBusiness.
Check the fare's included cabin and checked-baggage allowance on ValueJet's official site.
Weigh and size the bags before travel and separate the 7kg cabin bag from checked baggage.
Purchase an extra bag through the airline's website or booking-management route when the fare allows additional baggage and more capacity is needed.
Present checked baggage at the airport and retain the baggage tag until the bag is collected at the destination.
notes: ValueLite and ValuePlus currently include one checked bag up to 23kg; ValuePremium and ValueBusiness show two checked bags up to 30kg on the airline's current site.
ValueJet publishes a 7kg hand-luggage allowance with a 40cm × 20cm × 55cm size reference on its site.
Extra baggage and fare inclusions can change, so the live fare page should be checked before travel.

title: How to book an Aero Contractors flight
summary: Aero Contractors' official booking route for selecting a domestic itinerary, entering passenger details, paying through the airline's platform and retaining the PNR/e-ticket sent after confirmation.
feeLabel: Fare varies by route and date
feeNote: Aero fares are calculated from the itinerary and tariff in effect at purchase. Review the live booking amount and fare conditions before payment.
timeline: Aero states that an internet booking is confirmed after payment and the reservation confirmation is displayed; the e-ticket is sent to the registered email and can also be retrieved with PNR and surname.
requirements: The origin, destination and travel date for the intended Aero flight
Passenger identity/contact details that match the person who will travel
A valid photo identification document for airport check-in and boarding
A supported payment method for the fare shown by Aero's official booking platform
steps: Open Aero Contractors' official website and use the Booking form to select the travel route and date.
Choose an available flight and enter the passenger and contact information.
Review the fare and ticket conditions before completing payment.
Save the booking confirmation/PNR displayed after the successful transaction and check the registered email for the e-ticket.
If payment succeeds but the ticket is not confirmed, use Aero's official ticket-helpdesk contact rather than paying again immediately.
notes: Aero's conditions say a reservation is not made until payment is received and a confirmation number is issued.
The carrier requires photo identification at check-in and boarding.
Ticket change/refund eligibility depends on the fare conditions and Aero's current carriage rules.

title: How to manage or check in for an Aero Contractors flight
summary: Aero Contractors' Manage/Check-In route for retrieving a booking, updating eligible travel plans and completing the airline's check-in process before its published deadline.
feeLabel: Change charges and fare differences can apply
feeNote: Aero's conditions state that some fares are changeable only on payment of a change fee plus any fare difference. Check the booked fare before confirming a modification.
timeline: Aero's current Conditions of Carriage state a 40-minute check-in deadline unless another deadline is specified by the airline or airport authority.
requirements: The Aero booking reference/PNR and passenger surname or booking information required by Manage/Check-In
Valid photo identification for check-in and boarding
A ticket whose fare rules permit any requested booking change
Payment for any applicable change fee and fare difference when modifying the itinerary
steps: Open Aero Contractors' official website and select Manage / Check-In.
Retrieve the reservation with the booking information requested by Aero.
Complete the check-in flow or choose an eligible booking change when the ticket rules permit modification.
Pay any change fee and fare difference shown for a modified itinerary and save the new confirmation.
Report to the airport before the applicable check-in/boarding deadline with the required photo identification and baggage.
notes: Aero's current carriage conditions state that failure to meet the check-in deadline can result in cancellation of the reservation and denial of boarding.
Some discounted fares can be partly or fully non-changeable.
The website's Manage/Check-In section also supports retrieval of an existing booking.

title: How to request an Aero Contractors ticket refund
summary: Aero Contractors' refund route using the airline's refund request form, photo identification and passenger/payment evidence, with current deductions, non-refundable promotional fares and a published processing period.
feeLabel: Voluntary refund deduction currently 25% of ticket cost
feeNote: Aero's refund form states a 25% administrative deduction on voluntary ticket refunds, plus different regional/international and agent-related deductions where applicable. Promotional fares can be non-refundable.
timeline: Aero's current refund form states that an eligible cash refund for an unused ticket is ready after 14 days from submission.
requirements: The completed Aero Contractors refund request form
A copy of a valid photo identification document for the passenger named on the ticket
The passenger's bank/payment information for the refund transfer
For a third-party refund recipient, the passenger's authorisation letter plus identification for both the passenger and receiving account holder
steps: Open Aero Contractors' official refund request form and read the current refund terms before submitting a voluntary cancellation.
Complete the passenger, ticket, contact and bank/payment information requested on the form.
Attach the valid photo identification and add the passenger authorisation plus account-holder ID when a third party will receive the refund.
Send the completed refund package through Aero's official refund route and keep the submission evidence.
Allow the published processing period for eligible unused-ticket refunds and use Aero's refund contact if the request remains unresolved.
notes: Aero's current form states a 25% administrative deduction for voluntary refunds and a separate no-show penalty.
The carrier says promotional fares cannot receive a voluntary refund.
When the airline cancels the flight, the form states that a full-fare refund is transferred rather than applying the voluntary deduction.
